topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: When I heard about the accusation, my hands started to fumble with my notebook, pages rustling under fingers that didn’t quite know what to do. The room felt a bit thick, like the air was suddenly made of something heavier, something I had to push through to speak. I kept my eyes on the desk, focusing on the grain of the wood rather than the faces around me. It’s not that I couldn’t look them in the eye; it’s just, there was so much to lose in a glance. Words seemed to tangle on my tongue, each one a step I had to carefully place. I wondered if I’d ever walk right again after this.
